title: Connect a Deploy App TAK Server
breadcrumb: Federation Hub: connecting multiple TAK Servers
Connect a Deploy App TAK Server

blocks.html:
With the hub running, trust exchanged, and a policy published, point each Deploy App TAK Server at the hub. Do this once per deployment.

On the hub (recap)

  • The deployment's CA (/opt/tak/certs/files/ca.pem) is uploaded to the hub (Establish trust).
  • The deployment has a CA Group node in the active policy, with edges + group filtering to the deployments it should share with (policy, filtering). Without this, the hub denies the connection.

On the TAK Server

  1. Enable federation. In the TAK Server UI, Configuration → Manage Federates, and if federation isn't on yet, Edit Configuration and enable it (ensure v2 is enabled).

  2. Trust the hub's CA. Under Manage Federate Certificate Authorities, upload the hub's ca.pem (from the hub's Settings → Download Self CA) so it goes into the server's federation truststore.

  3. Create the outgoing connection to the hub. On Manage Federates → Create Outgoing Connection, set:

    • Address = the hub's host
    • Port = 9102 (the hub's V2 federation port)
    • Protocol version = v2, plus a reconnect interval, and enable it.

    (Only one side needs to initiate. Alternatively, add an Outgoing node on the hub's policy graph pointing at the TAK Server instead — don't do both.)

  4. Map federated groups (optional). The server's own federated group mapping (Manage Groups per federate) controls which groups it offers out / accepts in; the hub's edge filtering then applies on top. For selective sharing, line these up with the group-filtering plan.

Verify

  • On the hub, the deployment's policy node turns green, and it appears under Active Connections (as a FEDERATION_TAK_CLIENT).
  • Generate something tagged with the shared group on one deployment and confirm it appears on the other. If it connects but nothing flows, it's almost always group filtering / group mapping.

Repeat for every Deploy App deployment you want in the federation — each just plugs into the same hub.
